profile.headline: Senior Software Developer | C# | .NET | Java | Spring Boot | Microservices | AWS | Azure | REST APIs | SQL | NoSQL
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Software Engineer / Senior Full-Stack Software Developer with strong experience designing and delivering scalable, cloud-native applications. I build high-performance, reliable software systems by combining clean architecture, modern engineering practices, and a deep understanding of business requirements.

My technical expertise includes .NET (ASP.NET Core), Python, microservices architecture, RESTful API development, and distributed systems deployed on AWS and Azure cloud platforms. I have hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, MongoDB, DynamoDB), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native patterns including containerization and serverless computing.

Throughout my career, I have contributed to and led enterprise-scale software engineering initiatives in regulated and high-traffic environments. I have delivered backend platforms, reusable APIs, and cloud solutions that support company-wide operations while following best practices in system design, Agile development, and DevOps.

I thrive in roles that combine hands-on software engineering, architectural decision-making, and technical leadership. My goal is to help organizations build future-ready software platforms while mentoring engineers and driving long-term technical excellence.
